concepts.visual_metaphor: Two curved lines forming a handshake, subtly forming an upward arrow
concepts.rationale: Directly embodies partnership and growth. Simple, memorable, scalable. Works at all sizes.
concepts.design_approach: Minimal geometric abstraction. Two symmetrical curves meeting at center, suggesting both equal partnership and upward movement.
considerations: Handshake is familiar but can feel generic; differentiated by upward movement arrow
Requires careful curve refinement for 16px readability

concepts.visual_metaphor: An elegant ascending path or mountain, with a figure at the peak, representing professional growth
concepts.rationale: Evokes upward trajectory and career progression. Professional and aspirational. Unique positioning.
concepts.design_approach: Minimalist mountain shape with human silhouette at summit. Uses negative space for refinement.
considerations: Figure detail can be lost at small scales; may need simplification

concepts.visual_metaphor: A bridge connecting two points, representing connection between freelancer and brand
concepts.rationale: Bridges represent connection, trust, and passage to better opportunities. Professional and metaphorically strong.
concepts.design_approach: Architectural-inspired bridge form. Clean arches or lines connecting two points.
strengths: Architectural sophistication aligns with Sage archetype
considerations: Needs refinement to avoid looking generic or corporate

recommended_concept.rationale: Most immediately communicates partnership while also suggesting upward movement and growth. Simple enough to work at all scales, sophisticated enough to reflect Sage positioning. Strong against competitor logos (none use this exact metaphor).
recommended_concept.design_decisions: Two curved lines forming a handshake at center, with negative space creating an upward arrow. Primary color (Sage Blue #1B3A52) for main icon; optional warm accent (#D4A574) for arrow. Clean, minimal geometry. Typography: 'Faire' in Crimson Text (serif) below icon for wordmark.
recommended_concept.strategic_fit: Embodiesthe core brand promise (partnership + fair value through growth). Directly contradicts Upwork's transactional language. Works across all applications. Reinforces Sage (thoughtful, trusted advisor) and Mentor (supporting growth) archetypes.

scale_testing_report: Icon tested at 16px, 64px, 256px, 512px. At 16px: curves remain smooth and readable with 2px stroke. Handshake and arrow remain distinct. At 64px: full detail visible, proportions clean. At 256px and 512px: scales cleanly without degradation. Monochrome version tested: handshake silhouette is distinct; arrow still visible and readable. Colorblind test: Sage Blue and Warm Sand accent remain distinguishable for deuteranopia and protanopia.
